subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot preserve one-message-per-safe-Markdown-chunk behavior, or merge chunks into one QQ bubble when the combined payload fits a verified safe limit?
rationale: Current source intentionally sends complete safe chunks, the open linked PR proposes a bounded merge, and a member comment says the current split behavior is by design; automation cannot choose the permanent channel UX policy.

options.title: Keep intentional chunking
options.body: Treat the current split behavior as the supported QQBot safety policy, document it if needed, and close or reject the merge-chunks PR.

options.title: Land bounded merge behavior
options.body: Refresh and land the linked QQBot PR after maintainer approval, keeping overflow chunking and deterministic failure handling.

recommendation.title: Keep intentional chunking
recommendation.body: Treat the current split behavior as the supported QQBot safety policy, document it if needed, and close or reject the merge-chunks PR.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp owns the most relevant recent QQBot Markdown chunking history, is assigned to the linked PR, and made the current by-design comment.
